raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On Ascend, `--moe-a2a-backend none --tp-size 2 --ep-size 2` fails with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B even without speculative decoding. The shared `AscendTPDispatcher` counts all 256 global experts while each rank owns 128 expert weights:

```text
groupList(tensor) 256 should be equal to weight dim 0 128
```

This affects the target model and any draft using the `none` dispatcher. Route tokens to each rank's local experts and combine its valid contributions through the model's existing all-reduce. Filtering also requires finalize mode 3: mode 2 does not handle the resulting `-1` row indices correctly.

Also make an explicit `--speculative-moe-a2a-backend none` inherit the target backend, matching an omitted option. With a DeepEP target, this selects DeepEP for the draft; with a `none` target, it still selects `none`, which needs the EP routing fix above.

## Modifications

- Map global expert IDs to local weight indices in the Ascend `none` dispatcher, preserve fused shared experts, and filter nonlocal/padding IDs using a nonnegative sentinel.
- Pass the local active expert range to NPU init routing so the expert-count tensor matches the local weights. Use finalize drop mode 3 for EP and view packed GMM output as a 3D capacity buffer without copying; EP1 retains mode 2.
- Resolve the draft backend with `spec.speculative_moe_a2a_backend not in (None, "none")`; otherwise use the target backend's default draft policy, preserving the upstream `flashinfer_megamoe` fallback to `none`. Keep raw-argument consumers consistent, including DeepEP v2 validation, DSpark validation, DeepGEMM memory planning, and FlashInfer autotuning.
- Update CLI help and documentation, add inheritance unit coverage, and make the Qwen3.6 NPU regression default to target `none`. It covers target-only inference plus MTP with the draft option omitted and explicitly set to `none`.

**Compatibility:** explicit draft `none` follows the same default policy as an omitted option across platforms. It normally inherits the target backend; the upstream `flashinfer_megamoe` exception is preserved and defaults the draft to `none`, because its global-expert-ID dispatch does not support typically unquantized draft layers. Other explicit backend values continue to override the target, subject to backend/model support. Inheriting a backend does not imply every model, quantization, or speculative algorithm is supported by it.

## Accuracy Tests

Validated on machine 151 with Ascend A3, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B BF16, TP2/EP2, CANN 9.1.0, PyTorch 2.10.0, and torch_npu 2.10.0.post6. NPU graphs are disabled and Mamba state uses BF16.

Controlled comparisons against base `8ac19cc19f` establish the routing bug independently of draft inheritance:

| Configuration | Without the NPU routing fix | With the NPU routing fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Target `none`, TP2/EP2, no speculative decoding | GMM fails: 256 expert counts vs. 128 weights | 5/5 answers correct; no speculative verification or draft tokens |
| Target/draft `none`, TP2/EP2, MTP; inheritance rule applied to both variants | Same GMM failure in the target worker | 5/5 answers correct; 5 verify calls, 5 proposed and 5 accepted draft tokens |
| Target/draft `none`, TP2/EP1, MTP; inheritance rule applied to both variants | Pass | Pass |

Updated-source validation at `fe717ffe5a`:

| Test | Result |
| --- | --- |
| MoE runtime-context and DeepEP v2 argument unit tests | 37/37 passed |
| Real-NPU dispatcher kernel regression | 7/7 passed |
| Target `none`, target-only inference | 5/5 answers correct; zero speculative verification/proposal/acceptance counts |
| Target `none`, MTP, draft option omitted vs. explicit `none` | Both passed; 5/5 answers and 5 verify/proposed/accepted draft counts per configuration; identical outputs |
| Target `deepep`, MTP, draft option omitted vs. explicit `none` | Both passed; 5/5 answers and 5 verify/proposed/accepted draft counts per configuration; identical outputs |

Two initial MTP launches stopped at the pre-model-load memory-balance check because other workloads occupied the selected NPUs. Their logs were retained. Both complete MTP comparisons passed after selecting available devices 10 and 11.

All successful model configurations return `42, 42, 56, 81, 15` for one single request and one four-request batch. The DeepEP comparison checks draft inheritance; it does not exercise the local `none` dispatcher.

Kernel coverage includes EP1, EP2, 256 global/128 local experts, no local tokens, shared experts and padding, INT8 routing, and empty batches. Logical ranks run sequentially on one NPU against a CPU dense reference; summing partial outputs checks the complete result. Unused GMM rows contain NaNs to detect invalid reads from dropped routes. The model tests cover actual cross-rank execution.

### Additional TP4/EP2 validation

Validated on machine 151 on 2026-09-29 using the same PR commit `fe717ffe5a`, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B BF16, and four NPUs (devices 12–15). Both cases use `--tp-size 4 --ep-size 2 --moe-a2a-backend none`, Ascend attention, BF16 Mamba state, and disabled NPU graphs.

| Configuration | Correct answers | Verify calls | Proposed draft tokens | Accepted draft tokens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Target only, no speculative decoding | 5/5 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Target + MTP, explicit `--speculative-moe-a2a-backend none` | 5/5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |

Both cases returned `42, 42, 56, 81, 15` for the same single-request and four-request-batch checks. MTP used `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 1 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 2` with an unquantized draft and Ascend draft attention.

Read-only runtime probes confirmed the hybrid expert/tensor-parallel layout on all four ranks:

- `moe_ep_size=2`, `moe_tp_size=2`, and `moe_dp_size=1`.
- 256 global experts and 128 local experts per rank; `group_list_len=128` and `drop_pad_mode=3`.
- Ranks 0/1 hold different TP slices of experts 0–127; ranks 2/3 hold different TP slices of experts 128–255. The local expert intermediate dimension is 256, half of the full dimension 512.
- Stored BF16 parameter shapes are `w13_weight=[128, 512, 2048]` and `w2_weight=[128, 2048, 256]` on every rank. The group-count length matches the local expert dimension of both weights.
- Probes covered all 40 target MoE layers on each rank and, in the MTP case, `mtp.layers.0.mlp.experts` on each rank (160 and 164 total probe records, respectively).

This run used an isolated copy of `test_npu_speculative_moe_a2a_qwen36.py`, changing its device requirement, TP launch argument, and TP assertion from 2 to 4 and removing the 2-NPU CI registration. Source and probe changes were recorded with SHA-256 hashes. The probes only read metadata and tensors; they do not change routing or computation. Server responses and every probe record were checked after execution.

These results validate the `none` dispatcher with TP greater than EP for the tested BF16, graph-disabled model configurations. They are functional smoke tests, not a throughput benchmark or coverage of quantized/graph-enabled execution.

### Validation after merging main (2026-10-13)

Merged main `aa15b06abe` into this branch as `48ca6bca3b`. The conflict resolution keeps explicit draft `none` equivalent to an omitted option while retaining main's `flashinfer_megamoe` draft fallback. CLI help and the general speculative-decoding documentation describe the exception.

- **51/51 related unit tests passed on machine 151**, covering `TestMoeFlagsGroup`, `TestDeepEPv2Args`, and `TestFlashinferMegaMoeConfig` from the merged source.
- Extended the MegaMoE default test to cover both omitted and explicit `none` draft settings, the active draft context, and restoration of the target backend after leaving that context. The upstream explicit-backend override test also passes.
- Formatting, lint, registered-test checks, and `git diff --check` passed. The Windows launcher for `destroyed-symlinks` was blocked by application control; the same hook passed when run directly as a Python module.
- The three NPU routing implementation files are unchanged from `fe717ffe5a`. The TP2/EP2 and TP4/EP2 model results above remain the earlier measured results at that commit; full model inference was not rerun for this conflict-resolution update.

### Reproduction

Reproduce the registered TP2/EP2 tests from the repository root:

```bash
python test/registered/npu/basic_function/parallel_strategy/expert_parallelism/test_npu_none_dispatcher.py -v

# Default target/draft backend: none. Runs target-only and both MTP variants.
ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 \
SGLANG_TEST_MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B \
python test/registered/npu/basic_function/speculative_inference/test_npu_speculative_moe_a2a_qwen36.py -v

# Both draft settings resolve to DeepEP; this checks inheritance.
ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 \
SGLANG_TEST_MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B \
SGLANG_TEST_TARGET_A2A=deepep \
python test/registered/npu/basic_function/speculative_inference/test_npu_speculative_moe_a2a_qwen36.py \
  TestNpuSpeculativeMoeA2AQwen36.test_draft_backend_override -v
```

GPU model execution, a complete INT8 model, MXFP8, and NPU graph execution were not tested. INT8 kernel coverage checks routing quantization/dequantization and combination only.

Applicable pre-commit checks passed, with three Windows `python3` launcher failures rerun successfully using the available Python interpreter. `mint validate` passed. The site-wide broken-link scan reports 488 existing broken links in 126 files; this change edits documentation text only, without changing links or anchors.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance benchmark was run. Regression-test durations are not throughput or latency comparisons.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code and run applicable pre-commit checks.
- [x] Add registered NPU regression tests and inheritance unit coverage.
- [x] Document backend semantics and reproduction commands.
- [x] Provide functional accuracy results.
- [ ] Provide a speed benchmark (not run).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

+"""Check local EP routing against a dense reference using real NPU kernels.
+
+One NPU runs each logical EP rank sequentially; summing its partial outputs
+models the all-reduce performed by the model after the ``none`` dispatcher.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.base import MoeRunnerConfig
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.token_dispatcher.ascend_tp import (
+    AscendTPCombineInput,
+    AscendTPDispatcher,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import StandardTopKOutput
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_npu
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_npu_ci(est_time=30, suite="full-1-npu-a3", nightly=True)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_npu(), "Requires Ascend NPU kernels")
+class TestNpuNoneDispatcher(CustomTestCase):
+    def _check_routing(self, ids, num_routed=4, ep_size=2, num_shared=0, int8=False):
+        ids = torch.tensor(ids, dtype=torch.int32).reshape(-1, 2)
+        num_tokens, top_k = ids.shape
+        num_experts = num_routed + num_shared
+        local_routed = num_routed // ep_size
+        num_local = local_routed + num_shared
+        # Binary fractions make BF16 matmul/combine exact; distinct expert
+        # transforms detect a wrong rank offset even when count shapes match.
+        x = ((torch.arange(num_tokens * 32) % 13 - 6) / 8).reshape(num_tokens, 32)
+        weights = torch.stack(
+            [torch.eye(32).roll(expert % 32, dims=1) for expert in range(num_experts)]
+        )
+        scores = torch.tensor([0.25, 0.75]).repeat(num_tokens, 1)
+        expected = torch.zeros_like(x)
+        for row in range(num_tokens):
+            for slot in range(top_k):
+                expert = int(ids[row, slot])
+                if expert >= 0:
+                    expected[row] += scores[row, slot] * (x[row] @ weights[expert])
+
+        total = torch.zeros_like(x)
+        for rank in range(ep_size):
+            with self.subTest(rank=rank):
+                config = MoeRunnerConfig(
+                    num_experts=num_experts,
+                    num_local_experts=num_local,
+                    num_fused_shared_experts=num_shared,
+                    top_k=top_k,
+                )
+                with patch(
+                    "sglang.srt.layers.moe.token_dispatcher.ascend_tp.get_parallel",
+                    return_value=SimpleNamespace(moe_ep_size=ep_size, moe_ep_rank=rank),
+                ):
+                    dispatcher = AscendTPDispatcher(config)
+                if int8:
+                    dispatcher.set_quant_config({"dispatcher_output_dtype": "int8"})
+                local_ids = list(range(rank * local_routed, (rank + 1) * local_routed))
+                local_ids += list(range(num_routed, num_experts))
+                local_weights = weights[local_ids].clone()
+                # Shared experts are replicated across EP ranks. Their caller
+                # supplies the 1/EP scaling; the dispatcher must keep them local.
+                if num_shared:
+                    local_weights[-num_shared:] /= ep_size
+                local_weights = local_weights.to(device="npu", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+                topk = StandardTopKOutput(
+                    topk_weights=scores.to(device="npu", dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+                    topk_ids=ids.npu(),
+                    router_logits=None,
+                )
+                hidden = x.to(device="npu", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+                # Repeat to cover cached expert mappings and cleared combine state.
+                for _ in range(2):
+                    dispatched = dispatcher.dispatch(hidden, topk)
+                    counts = dispatched.expert_tokens.cpu()
+                    self.assertEqual(counts.numel(), local_weights.shape[0])
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        counts,
+                        torch.tensor([(ids == expert).sum() for expert in local_ids]),
+                    )
+                    permuted = dispatched.hidden_states
+                    if int8:
+                        self.assertEqual(permuted.dtype, torch.int8)
+                        permuted = (
+                            permuted.float()
+                            * dispatched.hidden_states_scale.float().reshape(-1, 1)
+                        ).to(torch.bfloat16)
+                    expert_output = torch.ops.npu.npu_grouped_matmul(
+                        [permuted],
+                        [local_weights],
+                        group_list=dispatched.expert_tokens,
+                        group_type=0,
+                        split_item=3,
+                        group_list_type=dispatched.group_list_type,
+                    )[0]
+                    # Unused GMM rows are undefined. Poison them so a finalizer
+                    # that accidentally reads dropped routes cannot pass by luck.
+                    expert_output[int(counts.sum()) :].fill_(float("nan"))
+                    actual = dispatcher.combine(AscendTPCombineInput(expert_output))
+                    partial = torch.zeros_like(x)
+                    for row in range(num_tokens):
+                        for slot in range(top_k):
+                            expert = int(ids[row, slot])
+                            if expert in local_ids:
+                                scale = 1 / ep_size if expert >= num_routed else 1
+                                partial[row] += (
+                                    scores[row, slot]
+                                    * scale
+                                    * (x[row] @ weights[expert])
+                                )
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        actual.float().cpu(), partial, rtol=0, atol=0.008 if int8 else 0
+                    )
+                total += actual.float().cpu()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(total, expected, rtol=0, atol=0.008 if int8 else 0)
+
+    def test_ep1(self):
+        self._check_routing([[0, 2], [1, 3]], ep_size=1)
+
+    def test_ep2(self):
+        self._check_routing([[0, 2], [1, 3], [2, 3], [0, 1]])
+
+    def test_ep2_qwen36_expert_count(self):
+        self._check_routing(
+            [[0, 127], [128, 255], [255, 1], [129, 126]], num_routed=256
+        )
+
+    def test_ep2_no_local_tokens(self):
+        self._check_routing([[2, 3]])
+
+    def test_ep2_shared_experts_and_padding(self):
+        self._check_routing([[0, 4], [2, 4], [-1, 4]], num_shared=1)
+
+    def test_ep2_int8_routing(self):
+        self._check_routing([[0, 2], [1, 3], [2, 3], [0, 1]], int8=True)
+
+    def test_ep2_empty_batch(self):
+        self._check_routing([])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Exercise main/draft MoE routing on two Ascend NPUs with Qwen3.6.
+
+Example (from the repository root):
+    ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 \
+    SGLANG_TEST_MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B \
+    python test/registered/npu/basic_function/speculative_inference/test_npu_speculative_moe_a2a_qwen36.py -v
+
+SGLANG_TEST_TARGET_A2A and SGLANG_TEST_DRAFT_A2A default to none. The default
+covers the NPU none dispatcher at EP=2, both without a draft and with MTP.
+Draft none inherits the target backend, just like an omitted draft option.
+Set SGLANG_TEST_TARGET_A2A=deepep to check inheritance of DeepEP instead.
+Set SGLANG_TEST_EP_SIZE=1 to exercise the unsharded-expert TP path.
+SGLANG_TEST_LOG_DIR preserves the server logs and response/metric artifacts.
+Uses the launch/cleanup pattern in python/sglang/test/ascend.

+

+            "SGLANG_TEST_MODEL_PATH",

+        )
+        self.target_backend = os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_TARGET_A2A", "none")
+        self.draft_backend = os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_DRAFT_A2A", "none")
+        self.ep_size = int(os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_EP_SIZE", "2"))
+        log_dir = os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_LOG_DIR")
+        if log_dir is None:
+            temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sglang-npu-spec-a2a-")
+            self.addCleanup(temp_dir.cleanup)
+            log_dir = temp_dir.name
+        self.log_dir = Path(log_dir)
+        self.log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        self.session = requests.Session()
+        self.session.trust_env = False
+        self.addCleanup(self.session.close)
+        tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model, trust_remote_code=True)
+        self.answers = ["42", "56", "81", "15"]
+        self.prompts = [

+                [
+                    {

+                        "content": f"Calculate {expression}. Reply with only the integer answer.",
+                    }
+                ],
+                tokenize=False,
+                add_generation_prompt=True,
+                enable_thinking=False,
+            )
+            for expression in ["19 + 23", "7 * 8", "9 * 9", "45 / 3"]
+        ]
+
+    def _run_backend(self, label, draft_backend, *, speculative=True):
+        base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{get_open_port()}"
+        args = [
+            "--device",
+            "npu",
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "ascend",
+            "--trust-remote-code",
+            "--dtype",
+            "bfloat16",
+            "--mamba-ssm-dtype",
+            "bfloat16",

+                "EAGLE",
+                "--speculative-num-steps",
+                "1",
+                "--speculative-eagle-topk",
+                "1",
+                "--speculative-num-draft-tokens",
+                "2",
+                "--speculative-draft-model-quantization",
+                "unquant",
+                "--speculative-draft-attention-backend",
+                "ascend",
+                "--speculative-moe-runner-backend",

+            ]

+            "SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK": "128",
+            "TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM": "false",
+        }
+        log_path = self.log_dir / f"{label}.log"
+        with log_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log_file:
+            process = None
+            try:
+                process = popen_launch_server(
+                    self.model,
+                    base_url,
+                    timeout=900,
+                    other_args=args,
+                    env=env,
+                    return_stdout_stderr=(log_file, log_file),
+                )
+                info_response = self.session.get(f"{base_url}/server_info", timeout=30)
+                info_response.raise_for_status()
+                info = info_response.json()
+                self.assertEqual(info["tp_size"], 2)
+                self.assertEqual(info["ep_size"], self.ep_size)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    info["speculative_algorithm"], "EAGLE" if speculative else None
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(info["moe_a2a_backend"], self.target_backend)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    info["speculative_moe_a2a_backend"],
+                    draft_backend if speculative else None,
+                )
+                if not speculative:
+                    self.assertIsNone(info["speculative_draft_model_path"])
+                outputs = []
+                # Cover a single request and a batch with distinct lengths/content.
+                for prompts, answers in [
+                    (self.prompts[:1], self.answers[:1]),
+                    (self.prompts, self.answers),
+                ]:
+                    response = self.session.post(
+                        f"{base_url}/generate",
+                        json={
+                            "text": prompts,
+                            "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0, "max_new_tokens": 64},
+                        },

+                    (self.log_dir / f"{label}.json").write_text(
